title: Kendall Lucas
text:
Hi, thanks for visiting my website!


I’m a Data Science Major and Mathematics Minor at Duquesne University in Pittsburgh, PA. I’m especially passionate about how data can be used in the advancement in sports. Along with my studies, I am a collegiate athlete and run cross country and track.



Last summer I am participated in the Carnegie Mellon Sports Analytics Camp. Here, I researched the effects of transferring on player performance in Division I men’s basketball. This project was super appealing to me because being a student-athlete myself, I know the system behind transferring and eligibility rules in the NCAA.
Prior to this research, I developed a small personal project, using data from my own Garmin running device. To help me balance my workload, volume to decrease injury risk, and track overall performance metrics, I analyzed this dataset in order to gain a deeper understanding my running activities.
